name: Haramasete Valkyrie
source:
The main character is a low-class male angel. But one day, he is expelled from heaven. He meets Eleanor, a valkyrie, and begins to serve under her. A while later, he hears a rumor that one can get power by learning a special magic. However, he isn't strong enough to learn it.... So he decides to make Eleanor his sex slave and uses her as his tool. To do that, he thinks of confining Sigurd, Eleanor's ex-boyfriend. He successfully catches and confines Sigurd and calls Eleanor, Iris, and Eunice, Eleanor's daughter, to his fastness....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角是一位低等的男性天使。但有一天，他被逐出了天堂。他遇到了女武神埃莉诺，并开始在她手下服役。不久之后，他听到了一个谣言，说学习一种特殊的魔法可以获得力量。然而，他的实力还不够强，无法学会……所以他决定让埃莉诺成为他的性奴隶，并利用她作为他的工具。为此，他考虑限制埃莉诺的前男友西格德。他成功地抓住并囚禁了西格德，并把埃莉诺、艾丽丝和埃莉诺的女儿尤妮斯叫到了他的要塞……
